notes:
This version is required: Meki Cloud sync asks older Macs to update.

New
- Meki on your iPhone: the library’s Show this library on your iPhone switch, the iPhones on the library in Settings › Account, and requests an iPhone sends for a Mac to carry out

Improved
- Looking up where a drive is mounted takes less time while tasks run

Fixed
- Releasing an item in Outputs from two Macs at once publishes it once, and each release of a plugin item is counted on its own
- Back to draft’s Undo follows this Mac’s clock
- An original leaves a drive only after Meki has read another copy of it whole, in the same run, on the drive itself
- A drive Meki doesn’t recognise says so (“its Meki marker is missing”) instead of being taken for one it knows; remounts and clock changes no longer make an old check count
- Deleting a drive’s catalog backup reads the other copies first, stops if the catalog changes meanwhile, and keeps what waits for another drive for Retry
- A busy archive catalog is waited for instead of read as missing
- Folders: Delete all deletes only what was confirmed and refuses moves into the folder while it runs
- Edit: preset thumbnails draw once the photo’s render is ready, and masks draw within their limits
- Scripts: a script reads pixels only of the photos in its run, Undo run… finds what a crash left behind, and triggers no longer keep a catalog on an absent drive waiting
- The plan list shows a gallery’s unread visitor comments (“2 new”)
- Each file issue is noted once per check
